<thought>From the observed isotopic envelope (dominant M, decreasing M+1, M+2, etc.) the only element whose natural isotopic pattern matches the relative intensities (≈5 % for M+1, ≈0.5 % for M+2, rapidly diminishing thereafter) is carbon. No characteristic chlorine, bromine, sulfur, or other element patterns are present, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
